findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-topology.ts:635 mode-dependent status derivation downgrades missing/partial/unsupported basis to status=warn in observe/warn, but returns inconclusive only in enforce because status branches on blocking. This violates B98B0-M1-E-NONPASS-BASIS and B98B0-M1-E-MODES: basis incompleteness must remain INCONCLUSIVE and the canonical evaluation result must be mode-invariant; only blocking may differ. The focused mode loop exercises only clean complete bases, so it cannot detect this regression. Derive status from structural/basis semantics independently of mode, then derive blocking from mode, and add failing-basis assertions across observe/warn/enforce.

doc-code-drift: Wave 2 is documented as leaving measured rollout for Wave 4 and the authoritative execution plan forbids enabling enforce before measured criteria are approved, but transition-orchestrator immediately consumes proofStory.devGateMode and this repository already sets that flat project value to enforce. Thus merging this Story activates the new topology blocker project-wide now, contradicting docs/CLI.md:463-464 and the execution-plan rollout boundary/non-goal; the B-98b0 decision did not account for the pre-existing enforce value. Repro: lattice.config.json:30-33 plus packages/main/src/handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts:468-485; node bin/lattice.js acceptance_topology_check --storyId=B-98b0 --json reports mode=enforce and blocking=true. Resolve with an explicit rollout-safe activation consistent with the plan (or a documented human approval plus measured criteria), then make CLI guidance state the actual activation boundary.
